inherited_last_verdict: FALSIFIES — The truncation-artifact hypothesis is decisively falsified. Full-DOM canonical recipe ranking agreement for tag_entropy x DEF-FULL-MAP is 37.26%, which is 18.69pp BELOW the truncated-first-20 baseline (55.95%) and far below all preregistered thresholds (C5: 60.95%, C6: 75%). Per-task agreement collapses from 78.65% to 11.41% (−67.24pp). The ranking instability is NOT a truncation artifact; it WORSENS with full DOM elements. F1 and F2 both trigger. The hypothesis (H1 >=80%, H2 >=+10pp, H3 >=85%) is falsified across all three conditions. Controls pass (PC1 eta2=1.0, NC1 eta2=0.0, C4 max eta2=0.99996), confirming the pipeline is functioning; the negative result is scientific, not infrastructural. Audit REVISE corrects B3 non-recipe ranking preservation (actually 0% for tag_entropy/form_fraction due to direct vs pipeline ranking inversion), within-type clone degeneracy (identical locatable_samples per type inflate discrimination), and hash salt non-determinism — none change the falsification direction. The Bootstrap CI is degenerate [0,1] due to binary ranking agreement across bootstraps with N=7 tasks, consistent with within-type clone degeneracy.
